instruction: Help me to install Yaru theme from gnome-look.org and set it as the active theme for my GNOME desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing Yaru theme from gnome-look.org and applying it to GNOME desktop. Evaluator checks if gtk-theme setting contains 'Yaru' using gsettings command. Similar to original task but with different theme name.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme' to check the active GTK theme setting, which is the appropriate method for GNOME theme verification
The check_list metric with regex pattern 'Yaru' appropriately matches the theme name in gsettings output (which returns quoted strings like 'Yaru' or 'Yaru-dark')
Postconfig correctly executes the gsettings command after task completion to verify the theme was set
The regex pattern 'Yaru' will match all Yaru theme variants (Yaru, Yaru-dark, Yaru-light, etc.), which is appropriate since the instruction doesn't specify a particular variant

While the evaluator doesn't explicitly verify theme installation (only checks if theme is active), setting a theme as active implicitly confirms it was installed - you cannot activate a theme that doesn't exist
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Could add verification that the theme file exists in ~/.themes or /usr/share/themes to explicitly confirm installation, but this is not critical since activating a theme proves it was installed
